name: create-site
description: Creates a new Power Pages code site (SPA) from a curated template or from scratch using React, Angular, Vue, or Astro. Guides through the full process from initial concept to deployed site: requirements discovery, template selection or scaffolding, component planning, design, implementation, validation, and deployment. Use when the user wants to create, build, use a template for, or scaffold a new Power Pages website or portal.
